items.title: Mock 1 — Select Missing Word Q1 (Triggers)
items.audioTextStart: They see triggers all over the world. What are triggers? Triggers are cases where you take a part of your nervous system and you say, if someone says that word they can control my nervous system and make me afraid and anxious. That's a terrible idea. We should not be teaching our kids to see the world as being full of triggers. We should teach them to live in a world that is physically quite safe but full of offensive statements and ideas especially on the Internet. A sad commentary on the state of the business world now is that Google is being sued from both sides, from women who say that they're victims of a hostile climate, and from conservatives and white men, who say that conservatives and white men are discriminated against.
